newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan bourse derivative trade temporary suspension.
newsitem.headline: Milan bourse derivative trade temporary suspension.

text.p: Derivatives trading on the Milan stock exchange was temporarily suspended on Tuesday due to technical problems, said the managers of the derivative trading system.

Trading was suspended at 0855 GMT after a regular opening. At the moment of suspension, the March FIB30 contract was up 83 points at 17,285 with 1,633 lots traded, and the June contract up 34 points at 17,415 with 601 lots traded.
